rubric: Read only pair.png in the current directory. Blind pairwise visual-quality evaluation of fluid renders. Left/right panels each show the SAME scene at wall times 2, 5, 10, 20 seconds, left-to-right. Top row: whole frames. Bottom row: matching native-pixel detail crops, chosen from one variant without regard to quality. Compare fluid render quality, NOT the preferred arrangement of chaotic swirls. Prefer more resolved fine detail, richer vivid colour, clean smooth gradients, coherent filaments and vortices; penalize blur, muddy/desaturated colour, coarse numerical diffusion, blockiness or aliasing. Do not infer labels or which side is a reference. Different swirl positions alone are not quality differences. Tie if visually indistinguishable in quality. Stills cannot establish temporal/frame-rate smoothness; assess only spatial smoothness. Return ONLY JSON {"verdict":"left"|"right"|"tie","reason":"short visual evidence"}.
